title: 第一卷 第9章 新的活法
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
薛凤：“这……这应该不能吧。”

    “咱都一家人，阿华不至于这么算计。”

    “我去找他问问。”

    李文：“还找什么找，问了也白问。”

    “他要说早说了，不死到临头，他能承认吗？”

    任琴说道：“阿凤，你就别替那小王八蛋说话了。”

    “阿文说的对。”

    “都明摆的事情了。”

    “这赌债，就让他自己还，你们别管他。”

    说完。

    低着头，藏住泛红的眼睛，刚才有多高兴，现在就有多失望。

    她哆嗦着手，拿起梭子继续做渔网。

    薛凤说道：“那也得喊他回家，不能让他在老屋住着，咱想管都不好管。”

    李文叹口气，转身走进屋里。

    薛凤跟上去。

    进了屋。

    李文抽完一根，又续了一根，问道：“阿凤，咱管不管？”

    薛凤迟疑了一下，说道：“管吧。”

    “咋能不管。”

    “咱可答应爸的。”

    李文看着薛凤，一脸愧疚：“苦了你了。”

    他当哥的。

    照顾弟弟天经地义。

    可当嫂子的，给小叔子一次次“擦屁股”，可没那义务。

    薛凤摇摇头，说道：“上次阿华把人打伤，妈是把她最后的钱都掏了出来，她肯定拿不出钱来了。”

    “咱家还有三百零五块三毛二。”

    “也不够还的。”

    李文说道：“那就还有千把块钱的缺口，这好办。”

    “咋好办？”

    “我再找老板预支一个月的工资。”

    “上次那事……你都预支几个月的工资了，你老板还能同意吗？要不我去我爸妈那边问问吧。”

    “你先别去，我先去找老板，要是能行，你就别去找你爸妈张嘴了。”

    “行吧，后天退大潮，我和妈都去礁石滩，没准运气好要能抓到好货卖钱。”

    “那地方太危险了。”

    “没事，小心点就成，这不家里急用钱……”

    “对了，你说阿华送来三个大青蟹？在哪呢？”

    “在厨房，你……”

    李文赶紧走到厨房，看到三个缺胳膊断腿的青蟹，气的不行，要揍守着的李天佑：“你弄断的？”
content_en:
Xue Feng: "This...this shouldn't be possible."

    "We are all a family, Ah Hua won't be so scheming."

    "I'll go find him and ask."

    Li Wen: "What else are you looking for? Asking is in vain."

    "If he wants to say it, he has told it a long time ago. Can he admit it until his death is imminent?"

    Ren Qin said: "A-Feng, please stop speaking for that little bastard."

    "Awen is right."

    "It's all obvious."

    "Let him pay off his gambling debt by himself and leave him alone."

    Finished.

    He lowered his head and hid his red eyes. He was so happy just now, but now he is so disappointed.

    With trembling hands, she picked up the shuttle and continued making fishing nets.

    Xue Feng said: "Then we have to ask him to go home. We can't let him live in the old house. It's hard for us to control him even if we want to."

    Li Wen sighed, turned around and walked into the house.

    Xue Feng followed.

    Entered the house.

    Li Wen finished smoking one, took another, and asked, "A-Feng, do we care?"

    Xue Feng hesitated for a moment and said, "Just take care of it."

    "Why don't you ignore it?"

    "We can promise dad."

    Li Wen looked at Xue Feng with a guilty look on his face: "I've suffered so much for you."

    He's a brother.

    Taking care of your younger brother is natural.

    But as a sister-in-law, she has no obligation to "wipe the butt" of her brother-in-law again and again.

    Xue Feng shook her head and said: "Last time Ah Hua injured someone, my mother took out all her last money. She will definitely not be able to get the money back."

    "We still have three hundred and five dollars and three cents left."

    "It's not enough to pay back."

    Li Wen said: "Then there is still a gap of a thousand yuan, which is easy to handle."

    "What should I do?"

    "I'll ask my boss to advance one month's salary."

    "What happened last time...you have advanced several months' salary, can your boss still agree? How about I go to my parents and ask."

    "Don't go yet. I'll go find the boss first. If that's possible, don't go to your parents to open your mouth."

    "Okay, the day after tomorrow when the tide goes out, my mother and I will go to the reef beach. Maybe we will be lucky enough to catch something good and sell it for money."

    "That place is too dangerous."

    "It's okay, just be careful. The family is in urgent need of money..."

    "By the way, you said Ahua sent three blue crabs? Where are they?"

    "In the kitchen, you..."

    Li Wen quickly walked to the kitchen and saw three blue crabs with missing arms and legs. He was so angry that he wanted to beat Li Tianyou who was guarding him: "Did you break them?"
